adn.resume_en: 100% show 3D relief/bevel (mean relief 7.4/10), 9% carry contour/rim glow (mean glow 2.1/10), 9% sit on a dark background and 0% on a gradient/atmospheric one, 0% of outlined marks use a thick (usually white) contour, 9% add particles/sparkles. Mean saturation 6.4/10, mean brightness 6.9/10, mean complexity 7/10. Dominant materials: fabric 21%, plastic 18%, water 13%, glass 13%. Background taxonomy: scene 100%. Dominant palette: #FFFFFF, #19C3D4, #0072FF, #0088FF, #4A4A4A.

composition: Symmetrical or split-level framing with key subjects occupying the lower 50% of the canvas.
Central vertical axis must remain clear in the upper 50% to host the primary logo overlay.
Use extreme low-angle or forced perspective to create a dramatic sense of scale and depth.
Incorporate strong horizontal or diagonal dividing lines (e.g., waterlines, steps, dashboards) at the 33% or 50% mark.
typographie: Integrate text directly into 3D models (e.g., on hulls, boards) rather than floating overlays.
Use bold, high-contrast sans-serif block lettering.
Match text perspective and lighting to the physical surface it is mapped onto.
taxonomie_fonds: scene: Detailed photographic or 3D-rendered environments (villas, coastal cities, retro rooms) with a clear, low-contrast sky or wall zone in the upper third for logo placement.
lumiere: Bright, direct midday sunlight casting sharp, high-contrast shadows directly beneath objects.
Warm golden hour side-lighting (from left or right) creating soft rim lights and long shadows.
Underwater light rays and surface caustics filtering down from the top edge.
etalonnage: Vibrant, high-saturation blues and turquoises (#00B0FF, #1E88E5, #19C3D4) dominating water and sky scenes.
Warm, earthy neutrals (#D99E6C, #E5CBB1, #8C583C) for urban stone, brick, and retro interiors.
Clean, high-value whites and light grays (#FFFFFF, #EAECEE) to maintain a luxurious, bright feel.
effets: Realistic water caustics, splashes, foam, and motion-blurred wakes.
Depth of field with sharp foreground elements and softly blurred backgrounds.
Subtle atmospheric haze, lens bloom, and warm light leaks.
logo: Position the logo centrally in the upper half of the frame, overlaying low-complexity zones like clear skies or flat walls.
Ensure high contrast against the background using drop shadows or clean negative space.
interdits: Avoid flat, low-contrast lighting that eliminates 3D depth.
Do not clutter the upper-central zone where the logo must sit.
Avoid oversaturated, unnatural neon color palettes that break the premium, realistic mood.
